priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the returned disposer
findings.body: Calling the returned cleanup function no longer invokes socket.off, so every attached handler remains subscribed permanently. Consumers that detach or reattach will continue receiving messages through stale handlers, causing duplicate processing and memory retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current head src/socket.ts returns an empty cleanup callback after registering socket.on("message", handler), so the handler remains attached and the cited leak persists at the exact reviewed head.
